title: Objectwise finite proper projection formula
statement: For a finite commutative ring Λ and a proper morphism g : Z ⟶ Y of schemes, every component (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat Λ) g).app M).app L) on the ordinary unbounded derived categories of small-etale Λ-module sheaves is an isomorphism.

proof.text: It suffices to prove invertibility after exact inverse image to every algebraic-closure point. Indeed exact inverse image commutes with all derived homology functors; its composition with the geometric-point fibre functor identifies with the corresponding geometric stalk on Y. Geometric stalks reflect isomorphisms of homology sheaves, and derived homology reflects isomorphisms of unbounded complexes.

Base change g to an algebraically closed point s. The fibre morphism is proper. A finite ring is additive torsion, so the unbounded proper base-change theorem makes both exchange components invertible. Projection-map/base-change compatibility expresses the pullback of the original projection map, followed by the exchange and tensor-comparison isomorphisms, as a composite of the fibre projection map and canonical monoidal/commutative-square isomorphisms. Cancel the invertible comparison maps.

The fibre projection component is invertible by the finite geometric-point projection theorem. Apply the preceding transport calculation first with an abstract algebraically closed field, then specialize to each algebraic-closure point of Y. Conservativity proves the original component invertible. Assemble the components twice by NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app to obtain finite_projection_iso.
